scope: Graph configured by dev Universe AlloyDB (oldest configuration row)

queries.weights: MATCH ()-[r]->() RETURN type(r) AS edge_type, count(r) AS count, count(r.weight) AS weighted, min(r.weight) AS min_weight, max(r.weight) AS max_weight, count(DISTINCT r.weight) AS weight_variants, sum(CASE WHEN trim(coalesce(r.description,'')) = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS missing_description ORDER BY edge_type
queries.properties: MATCH ()-[r]->() UNWIND keys(r) AS property RETURN type(r) AS edge_type, property, count(*) AS count ORDER BY edge_type, property
queries.patterns: MATCH (a)-[r]->(b) RETURN type(r) AS edge_type, labels(a) AS from_labels, labels(b) AS to_labels, count(r) AS count, collect(DISTINCT r.weight) AS weights ORDER BY edge_type
